Booking details

Clear rules for arena hours, stadium matches, and team bookings

Use this page to understand how bookings work before sending a request from the booking page.

Indoor arena

Hourly cricket slots

Indoor arena bookings are made by the hour. Captains can choose the date, start time, number of hours, and whether the slot is day or night.

Day ratePKR 1,300/hr
Night ratePKR 1,800/hr

Cricket stadium

Team match booking

Stadium booking is for team matches. A logged-in captain can select their own team and choose another listed team as the opponent.

  • Login is required before sending a stadium booking request.
  • Opponent teams are loaded from the team directory.
  • Booking status is tracked from the dashboard.

Status flow

Pending to confirmed

Every new booking starts as pending in your dashboard. It can then be reviewed, confirmed, or cancelled.

Pending Confirmed Cancelled

Captain checklist

Before you book

1Create or login to your team profile.
2Keep captain phone and team address updated.
3Select arena hours or a stadium opponent team.
4Check your dashboard for current booking status.
